# compute_sibling_keywords { #dyf.compute_sibling_keywords }

```python
compute_sibling_keywords(dag, titles, cluster_labels, n_clusters, *, top_k=8)
```

Compute contrastive TF-IDF keywords for clusters sharing tree parents.



## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

dag : CategoryGraph
titles : list[str]
    Per-item title strings.
cluster_labels : (n,) int array
    Per-item BIRCH cluster ID.
n_clusters : int
    Cluster resolution.
top_k : int
    Keywords per cluster.



## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

dict[int, list[tuple[str, float]]]
    ``{cluster_id: [("word", score), ...]}``.
